capabilities.name: Governed Education Publication and Admission
capabilities.responsibility: Publish reviewed, source-backed generic insurance concept education into an immutable education-only record and admit that record only for explicitly authorized customer-education explanation use.
capabilities.authority_role: Education-use publication and admission authority only; it cannot certify or satisfy operative product facts, determine entitlement or claim payment, infer customer-specific applicability, authorize recommendations, or substitute for AuthoritativePublicationRecord product evidence.
safety_invariants: Only human-reviewed governed generic concept meaning assets with preserved evidence lineage may be published.
Education publication authorizes CUSTOMER_EDUCATION only and fails closed for operative product-fact use.
Education publication records remain a distinct type from authoritative product evidence and cannot cross the ordinary USER_ANSWER product-evidence admission gate.
Affirmative claim-payment or coverage-guarantee language and recommendation language are not publishable as generic education.
Product-hosted source evidence is admissible only when product context is explicitly excluded from the extracted generic concept content.
Publication creates a content-addressed receipt without mutating the source governed meaning asset.
capabilities.notes: This capability is intentionally separate from rule certification and authoritative operative-product publication. Explanation wiring is a later extension and must preserve this use boundary.
